kernel_checks: For all 64 shifts T (with multiplicity), form and sort the distinct endpoints T,T+P. At every open cell between consecutive distinct endpoints evaluate K at its midpoint; at every distinct interior endpoint evaluate K exactly. Use the specified representative K(t)=#{T:T<t<T+P}/(64*P), so both support endpoints are zero. This exhausts the finite density cells and breakpoints of each fixture; no seven-sample-only positivity assertion.
discrete_checks: For each of the three non-anchor labels i, evaluate (1/4)*sum_{r=0}^3 1_{B_i}(t+r*p_i/4) at t=s_i (expected zero) and t=s_i+p_i/8 (expected 1/4). These explicit pointwise exceptions prevent misstatement of the discrete identity.
primary_method: Exact rational interval intersections. For each of 64 shifts T and each label, sum lengths of blocked train intervals intersecting [a+T,a+T+P]; divide the total length over all shifts by 64*P. Enumerate only the finitely many occurrences meeting these compact boxes. Density counts open-box memberships directly.
